predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Aberdeen vs Dundee: Expected Goals (xG), Defensive Crisis & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Backed by superior home expected-goal generation and Dixon-Coles probability weight, Aberdeen are projected to avoid defeat against Dundee in an open, multi-goal contest at Pittodrie.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw (Aberdeen 2:1 or 1:1): Blended modeling gives Aberdeen a 41.14% win and 26.25% draw share against a Dundee side with five defeats in seven away matches (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals & BTTS Yes: A 3.05 total goal expectancy and 14.3% clean-sheet rates for both teams support three or more goals with both attacks scoring (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
